summary: 周六较安静。raxhvl 为 EIP-7708 加入 ETH 销毁日志并统一规范，提交并合并。nerolation 的 EIP-8142 基于 ePBS（EIP-7732）重写合并。tkstanczak 介绍 corcoranwill 将协调以太坊后量子安全交付。

items.title: EIP-7708：加入 ETH 销毁日志并改进规范一致性
items.note: （raxhvl）提交并合并：ETH 可被铸造、转账与销毁，流通量或所有权的变化都应记录日志，重点是记录什么变了而非如何变；此前只有转账被正确记录。
items.title_en: EIP-7708: add ETH burn logs and improve spec consistency
items.note_en: (raxhvl), submitted and merged: ETH can be minted, transferred and burned, and every change in circulation or ownership should be logged, focusing on what changed rather than how; previously only transfers were logged correctly.
